weaknesses: Abstract claims theoretical generality unmatched in the literature without sufficient evidence.
The experimental setup lacks a comparison with other recent incremental certification methods.
The paper does not adequately address the limitations of the IRS method in scenarios with high perturbation levels.
strengths: Introduces a novel framework for incremental randomized smoothing certification that significantly reduces certification time.
Extensive empirical evaluation demonstrates substantial speedups over traditional methods, providing strong practical implications.
The paper clearly articulates the underlying theory and insights that support the proposed method.
